verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser runs AI browser agents (HyperAgent, Claude, OpenAI, BrowserUse), so letting users plug external MCP servers into those agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Hyperbrowser publishing its own MCP server, which serves its tools to other agents. That is the opposite role and does not transfer to this MCP-client story. Nothing shows users can connect external MCP servers to Hyperbrowser's agents or sessions.
